name: CommandPanel
description:
The palette's contents: search field, grouped results and keyboard hints. Rendered in
the modal palette, and on its own in the gallery.
signature: ({ commands, onRun, loading, groupOrder, defaultQuery, className }: CommandPanelProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: commands
props.description: Available slash commands and their typed arguments.

props.name: groupOrder
props.description: Preferred order of command or action groups.

props.name: loading
props.description: A source is still fetching: skeleton rows follow the results.

props.name: onRun
props.description: Called when run occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.
